# Subscribed harness state

The state directories of each harness this instance instantiates from a KG subscription: `<subscription>/<harness>/<state path>/`, one home per chosen harness, each state directory the harness declares created with a `.gitkeep`. Written by `bun run cat kg:instantiate`; the harness's processes write into it after that. Never at the repository root, where a harness named after a staged instance would write into that instance's directory (gap G11), and never under `subscriptions/`, which holds upstream's bytes and is read-only.

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `subscribed-harnesses`, holding `subscribed-harnesses`.

_This directory holds no files yet._
